limitations: All vaults, mint supply, fee schedules and balances are synthetic. These are unit-test fixtures, not real pools or trade recommendations.

Token-program labels are legacy and bare Token-2022 with NO extensions. Public quote functions do not take token-program ownership as an argument; the no-extension arithmetic is identical. This does NOT validate TransferFeeConfig, hooks, withheld fees or instruction-account routing.

Pure SDK conformance is not on-chain parity. Coherent account reads, owner checks, fee config validation, slot freshness, balances, transaction simulation and executable sell quotes remain observer acceptance requirements.
Only integer quote and layout APIs executed. No RPC, signing, wallet or paid service used.

Expected throws reflect SDK behaviour. Caller must ALSO reject nonpositive effective reserves, negative/zero amount, invalid decimals/slippage, unsupported extensions and out-of-range i128 before calling.
Synthetic feeConfig exact threshold boundaries; no claims that this schedule is current mainnet configuration.
sellQuoteInput inversion is SDK output, not a proof that forward net output always reaches target under separately rounded per-component fees; add a forward sellBaseInput guard.
